description: Search real charity stories a creator could make a video or post about. Matches the query against titles, summaries, charities, causes and places, and returns the best matches with a link to each story page.

cause.description: Only stories for this cause, e.g. "Health". Use list_causes for the values.

limit.description: How many stories to return (default 10, at most 25).

location.description: Only stories in this place, e.g. "Manchester".

query.description: Words to look for, e.g. "children Manchester" or "animal rescue".

name: search_stories_to_tell
title: Search stories to tell
